frame: Metres from the lot's bow-port corner: x toward the stern, y toward starboard, z above the deck.
source: Designed room by room for this building from its outline and its program in tools/room_programs, laid out with tools/design_rooms.py, 2026-11-27. All proposed.

elements.name: Great Hall
elements.about: The great hall itself, 98 ft (30 m) high and open to the roof, lit through the Skyglass wall that looks out on Haven's Reach. Every arriving passenger walks through it.

elements.name: In-processing circle
elements.about: The welcome point at the heart of the hall where new arrivals are in-processed and meet Avalon, Sentinel and Vector (canon).

elements.name: Seating island (bow)
elements.about: Benches and planters where travellers sit, get their bearings and wait for friends.

elements.name: Seating island (stern)
elements.about: Benches and planters where travellers sit, get their bearings and wait for friends.

elements.name: Arrivals boards
elements.about: Screens listing every arriving shuttle, its gate and where its passengers go next.

elements.name: Door to the arrival hangar
elements.about: The 66 × 33 ft (20 × 10 m) door through to the arrival hangar (placeholder size, TUNE).

elements.name: Stairs and lifts
elements.about: Stairs, lifts and service risers serving every floor; also the protected escape route in a fire.

elements.name: Corridor
elements.about: The corridor linking the rooms on this floor to the stairs and lifts.

elements.name: Main entrance hall
elements.about: Inside the 98 ft (30 m) wide main entrance (placeholder size), where people leave for the Arrivals Forecourt.

elements.name: Information desk
elements.about: Staff answer questions and hand out ship maps in every language.

elements.name: Greeters' office
elements.about: Base for the greeters who welcome each shuttle load of new arrivals.

elements.name: Guides' room
elements.about: Guides wait here to walk newcomers to customs, the terminals or the Keelway.

elements.name: Porters' station
elements.about: Porters and their luggage trolleys, ready to carry bags for arrivals.

elements.name: Arrivals clerks' office
elements.about: Clerks log every arrival and issue first passes and papers.

elements.name: Customs officers' post
elements.about: Customs officers watch the hall and send travellers on to customs and health screening.

elements.name: Assisted travel desk
elements.about: Help for travellers who need a wheelchair, a guide or extra time.

elements.name: Lost and found
elements.about: Things left in the hall are handed in and claimed here.

elements.name: Family room
elements.about: A quiet room with changing tables and play space for families after a long flight.

elements.name: Security desk
elements.about: Guards watch the cameras and the doors from here.

elements.name: First-aid room
elements.about: A couch, first-aid kit and defibrillator for anyone taken ill.

elements.name: Toilets
elements.about: Public toilets, with an accessible toilet and baby-changing room.

elements.name: Toilets
elements.about: Public toilets, with an accessible toilet and baby-changing room.

elements.name: Locker room
elements.about: Lockers and changing benches for staff arriving for their shift.

elements.name: Cleaners' room
elements.about: Cleaning machines, supplies and a sink for the building's cleaning crew.

elements.name: Waiting lounge
elements.about: Seats along the hall for people waiting for a connection or a friend.

elements.name: Kiosk
elements.about: Coffee, water and snacks for new arrivals.

elements.name: Corridor

elements.name: Gallery café
elements.about: A café on the gallery with views down into the great hall and out through the Skyglass wall.

elements.name: Viewing gallery
elements.about: An open gallery where visitors watch the hall and the shuttles outside.

elements.name: Hall control room
elements.about: Staff run the hall's lights, screens, doors and crowd flow.

elements.name: Arrivals management office
elements.about: The managers who run the Hall of Arrivals day to day.

elements.name: Customs supervisors' office
elements.about: Senior customs officers who oversee the hall's posts.

elements.name: Translation service
elements.about: Interpreters who help arrivals who don't speak the ship's languages.

elements.name: Tea point
elements.about: A small kitchen with a sink, fridge and drinks machine for staff on this floor.

elements.name: Staff toilets and showers
elements.about: Toilets, showers and changing space for the staff.

elements.name: Plant room
elements.about: Air handling units, pumps and electrical boards that keep this floor running.

elements.name: Comms room
elements.about: Network switches and the building's data and radio links.

elements.name: Quiet room
elements.about: A small quiet room for prayer, rest or a private moment.

elements.name: Staff office
elements.about: Desks for the hall's greeters, guides and clerks.

elements.about: A room for staff meetings and private talks with travellers.
